name: Acid Fog
description: Creates a cloud of deadly fog. The cloud blocks vision. Creatures take [HL]d4 ongoing dam. WIS save to move out/through the zone.

name: Alarm
description: Ward a zone up to 8hrs. You can designate creatures that will not sound the alarm. Auditory or mental. If sleeping, an auditory alarm will wake all in the zone. If mental, only the caster is awoken.

name: Animate Object
description: Object obeys your commands as best it can.

name: Anklecrusher
description: Creature or objects in the zone are immobilized. [HL]d4 damage. Prone creatures are auto-hit. STR Save to escape.

name: Arcane Eye
description: You can see through a magic bat-winged eyeball that you command. Caster must remain stationary or STR save to avoid becoming stunned.

name: Astral Prison
description: A creature or object is frozen in time and space within an invulnerable crystal shell. Permanent on a critical success.

name: Auditory Illusion
description: You create illusory sounds that seem to come from a direction of your choice.

name: Barrier
description: Create an immovable shimmering wall of force with [L]x5hp. [L] creatures may shelter behind it. Creatures, projectiles, etc. can only pass one way through the barrier.

name: Bat Wings
description: Your arms turn into huge bat wings. You can fly at twice your normal movement rate.

name: Belladonna's Miraculous Pit
description: Once per round summon or banish six 5' sq. cubes of matter. Summoned material will be the same as the target area (dirt, stone, metal, etc.). New cubes must be affixed to a surface or each other.

name: Charm
description: The person regards you as a good friend and ignores the obvious spell you just cast on them for [L] Dungeon Turns. Permanent on a critical success. Affects "people". If it worries about taxes, gossips, and wears pants, it's a person.

name: Color Spray
description: [HL]+1 creatures becomes slowed for [L] rounds.

name: Command
description: A creature who can see and hear you obeys a command of [L] words length. The command cannot directly cause the target harm, or force them to commit a directly harmful action.

name: Comprehend
description: You become fluent in all languages.

name: Conjure Elemental
description: Summon an elemental (air, earth, water, fire,) of [L]HD. Controlling the elemental requires full concentration. A caster can do nothing else but move. You cannot cast other spells. Caster may dismiss the elemental at any time, while they control it. If caster is distracted or takes damage, save vs WIL to maintain control. Otherwise the elemental retains its freewill and immediately tries to kill the caster and any who get in its way.

name: Control Plants
description: Nearby plants and trees obey you and gain the ability to move at 1 zone every 2 rounds.

name: Counterspell
description: As a reaction, or against an ongoing magical effect. On a successful save, you may cancel the spell being cast. Compare the caster's HD to your [L]. Step the DC of the WIL save up/down for every 2 HD difference.

name: Crow Friends
description: Conjure a murder of crows that flap and caw around the target. Target has DISADV on attacks and saves that require focus.

name: Death Mask
description: Touch a corpse and the face peels off like a mask. The rest of the corpse shrivels up and flakes into dust. When you (and only you) wear the mask, you look and sound like the person whose face you are wearing, but only to sentient living people. The mask will rot into uselessness after [L] days. Make an extreme WIL save to make permanent.

name: Detect Magic
description: You hear nearby magical auras singing. Volume and harmony signify the aura's power and refinement.

name: Disassemble
description: Any of your body parts may be detached and reattached at will, without causing pain or damage. You can still control them.

name: Dissolve
description: Target you stare at takes [HL]d6 ongoing acid damage and begins to dissolve as long as you take no other actions. Given time, you can melt locks, hinges, tripwires, or illusions with this spell. Makes a big mess.

name: Distort
description: Decouple yourself from linear time for [L] rounds or until struck. You appear as several blurry versions of yourself, all moving out of sync with one-another. Attacks against you have DISADV.

name: Earthquake
description: The ground begins shaking violently. Structures may be damaged or collapse. Creatures in the affected zone are knocked prone.

name: Elasticity
description: Your body can stretch into an adjacent zone. Duration: [L] rounds.

name: Enlarge
description: Creature becomes one size larger, gains [HL]+5hp, ADV on STR saves and damage rolls for all physical attacks. Duration: [L]+1 rounds.

name: Entangle
description: Thorny vines, grasping skeletal arms, slimy tentacles, etc. fill the target zone. Creatures in the affected area attack with DISADV, and attacks against them are made with ADV. Save vs STR to leave or enter the zone.

name: Exsanguination
description: Target's blood, brain, eyes, and nervous system is blown out of their body. Body collapses. Target's consciousness remains with the blood, which forms into a wet, noodley humanoid shape. [HL]1d8 ongoing dam. May move and attack as normal, but takes maximum damage from all attacks. Save vs STR to ooze back into the body.

name: Fairy Fire
description: Creatures and objects in a zone are outlined in magical light. Objects and creatures shed dim light (10' radius) for 1 Dungeon Turn. Attacks against them have ADV. Reveals invisible objects/creatures.

name: Feather Fall
description: You can cast this spell as a reaction to negate fall damage. You float gently to the ground.

name: Feeblemind
description: Creatures becomes an imbecile, unable to think clearly or cast spells for [L] rounds and makes attacks with DISADV.

name: Filch
description: [HL] visible tiny items in the same zone teleport to your hands.

name: Find Traps
description: Trapped objects glow with a magical light. No knowledge about the nature of the trap or how to disarm it is granted.

name: Fireball
description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. [L]d8 damage to all in target zone. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried ignite. Inflict ½ damage on a failed save.

name: Fog Cloud
description: Dense fog spreads out from you completely obscuring up to [HL] zones. WIS save to navigate the zone(s). Move in random direction on a failed save.

name: Frenzy
description: [HL] creatures erupt in a frenzy of violence and attack whomever is closest to them. Duration: [HL]+1 rounds. Save ends.

name: Frost Ray
description: [HL] targets are hit with an icy blast that slows them for [HL] rounds. Save ends.

name: Grease
description: Can be cast on a single creature, object, or zone. WIL save or creatures in affected area become prone.

name: Haste
description: Your movement speed and actions are doubled for [HL] rounds.

name: Hastur's Rotten Egg
description: A marble-sized bead of grey-green ooze lands at a point you select and detonates. Creatures in the zone must save vs STR or flee the area, as a failed morale check. The area is filled with a thick green mist that lasts for [HL] hours. The spell does not affect creatures with no sense of smell, mindless creatures, or creatures who habitually live in filth (goblins, shambling mounds, etc.)

name: Heat Metal
description: Cause a metal object you can see to glow red hot. Inflicts [HL]d8 ongoing damage to any creature touching the target of this spell.

name: Hold
description: [L]HD worth of creatures are paralyzed. It costs your action each round to maintain. On a failed save the targets are slowed.

name: Immobilizing Ooze
description: The target zone is filled with a dense cube of ooze. Creatures in the area are restrained. STR save to escape. 1D4 ongoing acid damage.

name: Knock
description: Object is opened. Doors are flung wide, locks are broken, shackles are bent open, belts come undone, and armor falls off. Unarmored creature, vomit for 1d4 rounds.

name: Leap
description: You can jump horizontally or vertically from one zone to your target zone without using your move action.

name: Levitate
description: You will an object to raise, lower, or hover frictionless 2ft above the ground. Maximum weight is 500 lbs.

name: Light
description: Summon magical light that illuminates as a torch. Can be cast on a willing creature or object and will move with that creature or object. WIL save to cast in a creature's eyes. If successful the creature is blinded for [L] rounds. Save ends. Cancels Night Sphere.

name: Lighting Bolt
description: Up to [HL]+1 creatures are engulfed in arching lighting. [HL]d8 damage.

name: Liquify
description: The object you target becomes a liquid version of itself and drips/runs like a thin oil until it pools on any flat surface. If the item has magical or alchemical properties, they become inert for the duration of the spell. If cast on a living creature everything but their skin liquifies, creating a convenient (though leaky) carrying vessel.

name: Liquid Air
description: The air around you becomes swimmable for [L] rounds.

name: Magic Jar
description: Enter a comatose trance and transfer your life-force into an inanimate receptacle. From there you may possess another creature you can see.

name: Magic Missile
description: Fire [HL] magic projectiles that automatically hit their target. Each inflicts 1d6 damage. Targets must all be in the same zone.

name: Manse
description: A sturdy, furnished cottage appears for [HL]x6 hours. You can permit and forbid entry to it at will.

name: Miniaturize
description: You or a creature you touch become tiny for [L] rounds. You temporarily lose 5hp and all damage dice go down one die size. Physical attacks against you have DISADV.

name: Mirror Image
description: Multi-wizard! You create [HL]+1 illusory images of yourself, which move as you move and always stay in your zone. They are constantly stepping through each other, so that it is impossible to tell which is which. Attacks against the caster automatically destroy one of the images, even if they miss but the caster is unharmed while they last.

name: Mirror Walk
description: A mirror becomes a gateway to another mirror that you looked into at any point in the past. Duration: [L] Turns.

name: Multi-arm
description: You gain extra set of arms. Gain an extra action. Duration: [L] rounds.

name: Night Sphere
description: A sphere of magical darkness displaying alien constellations appears for. Creatures are blinded unless they have magical vision.

name: Objectify
description: You become an inanimate object between the size of an apple (tiny) and a grand piano (large).

name: Ooze Form
description: You become a living jelly for [L] rounds. Squeeze through tiny gaps, porous surfaces, and small holes. Immune to acid damage.

name: Orbiting Spikes
description: [L] daggers of force orbit your head like angry bees. Beginning on your next turn you may mentally fire one dagger at a target (R1) as a free action. Roll WIL vs AC for these attacks.

name: Paper Automaton
description: Enchant a piece of paper, parchment, or vellum to obey your commands. The paper folds into a tiny humanoid shape and follows simple instructions. It can lift nothing heavier than a single coin, but it can write and read. It has [L]HP, AC12, and takes no damage from bludgeoning weapons.

name: Pass-Wall
description: Open a medium sized hole in solid rock or stone, forming a passageway up to [HL] zones deep.

name: Phantom Coach
description: A ghostly coach appears. It moves unnaturally fast over any terrain, including water. Lasts [HL] hours.

name: Polymorph
description: Transform self/other into another creature of HD equal to or less than the caster's [L]. WIL save for a creature 2HD higher than the caster's [L]. The WIL save is hard if 3HD higher, and extreme if 4HD higher. Spellcasting is impossible while transformed. The transformed creature assumes the physical stats and non-magical abilities of the creature it is transformed into. If killed, the creature reverts to its natural form.

name: Prismatic Spray
description: [L] rays flash from your fingers. Targets suffer a different effect depending on which color strikes the target. Roll 1d10: 1. Red. Target takes [HL]d6 ongoing fire damage. Spend an action to extinguish. 2. Orange. Target takes [HL]d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. 3. Yellow. Target takes [HL]d10 lightning damage. 4. Green. Target takes [HL]d6 ongoing acid damage. Spend an action to wipe it off. 5. Blue. Target takes [HL]d6 ice damage and must save vs STR to change zones. Save ends. 6. Purple. Target takes [HL]d6 necrotic damage and is blinded for [L] rounds. 7, 8, 9. Struck twice. Roll a d6 twice. 10. Struck thrice. Roll a d6 three times.

name: Push/Pull
description: A creature or object of large size or smaller is pulled towards you or pushed from you into/out of an adjacent zone.

name: Raise Dead
description: [L] skeletons rise from the ground to serve you. They are incredibly stupid and can only obey simple orders. Duration: until sunrise.

name: Raise Spirit
description: The spirit of a dead body manifests and will answer [HL] questions honestly and to the best of their ability.

name: Ravenous Void
description: Channel the cold hunger that lurks between the stars. Reality tears and tendrils of dark energy batter your foes, inflicting [HL]d6 damage and stunning them.

name: Read Mind
description: You can hear the surface thoughts of nearby creatures.

name: Reverse Gravity
description: reverse gravity in a column 4 zones high. Everything in the zone falls upwards. Of an obstacle or ceiling is encountered, creatures take 1d6 fall damage per zone fallen. DEX save to grab a fixed object and avoid falling. When the spell ends, creatures take fall damage again on the way back down.

name: Shape Water
description: Alter a body of water occupying [HL] zones. Change its direction, create shapes & animate the water, or cause it to freeze solid.

name: Shield
description: Summon a magical field that increases the caster's AC by +3.

name: Shocking Grasp
description: As part of a melee attack, enchant your hand so that it discharges [HL]d6 damage worth of lightning into the next thing you touch. Touching an unwilling opponent requires an attack roll against their unarmored AC (10+DEX). +1d4 damage if they are wearing metal armor.

name: Shove
description: Target is hurled through the air. A medium creature travels [HL] zones and takes 1d6 damage for every zone traveled. A creature thrown at another creature inflicts 1d4 damage for every zone traveled. This spell will also blow open unlocked doors in a room, shatter windows, or blow the roof off a peasant's cottage.

name: Shroud
description: Hold your breath. Become invisible. For [WIL] rounds. Casting spells or physically interacting with another creature cancels this spell.

name: Shuffle
description: Up to [HL]+1 creatures instantly switch places.

name: Silence
description: A circle of crackling white light appears at a point you designate, rendering that zone utterly silent. No sound can enter or leave the zone. Spellcasting is not possible within. Can be cast on a creature or object - caster must save vs WIL to target a creature.

name: Sleep
description: [HL]d6 HD worth of creatures fall into a magical slumber, and can't be awoken by anything less vigorous than a slap. Apply to creatures in ascending HD.

name: Smoke Form
description: Your body becomes living smoke for [L] rounds.

name: Spell Seize
description: Trigger: Another spell going off. Make a temporary copy of that spell which you can cast at any time before you stop for Short or Long Rest.

name: Spider Climb
description: You can climb surfaces like a spider for [HL] rounds.

name: Spider Mouth
description: Target creature vomits up 2d10 liters of spiders and is stunned. The spiders aren't hostile or venomous but their bites itch and they probably don't want to be held. Target loses next action. Save vs WIL each round thereafter to keep them puking.

name: Striking
description: Enchant a weapon. It deals +[HL] damage. Treat as magical weapon for 6 Turns.

name: Swarm
description: Become a swarm of bats, rats, piranhas, or other tiny creatures. You only take damage from blast attacks.

name: Telekinesis
description: You may mentally move [L] tiny, or [HL] medium, creatures or objects. Hard WIL save for large objects, extreme for huge.

name: Telepathy
description: [HL]+1 willing creatures can hear each other's thoughts, no matter how far apart they move. Duration: [L] turns.

name: Teleport
description: A medium object or creature disappears and reappears on the ground in a visible, clear area.

name: Thaumaturgic Anchor
description: Object becomes the target of every spell cast in, into, or through, its zone.

name: The Magnificent Sponge
description: Summon a sponge the size of your head. The sponge can instantly absorb up to [L] x10 liters of liquid without growing heavier. The sponge can be reused if it is wrung out completely. Duration: [HL] days. Pass an extreme WIL save and the sponge lasts for a year and a day, but the spell does not return to your spellbook until that time or the sponge is dispelled. The sponge is impervious to harm caused by the liquids it absorbs. Liquid still in the sponge when it vanishes or is dispelled splashes to the ground.

name: Thrash
description: Trigger: being struck by a melee attack. A writhing mass of tentacles erupt from your abdomen lashing out at up to [HL] enemies in your zone. Targets are flung [HL] zones and take [HL]d6 damage per zone thrown.

name: Thunderclap
description: Up to [HL]+1 creatures in the zone are knocked prone until the end of your next turn. On a failed save they are only stunned.

name: Thunderous Wave
description: Project a wave of force that affects up to [HL] +2 creatures in your zone that inflicts [HL]d6 damage. WIL save to also knock them prone.

name: Trapdoor Monster
description: A gigantic trapdoor spider appears beneath a solid surface you designate. The exact position of the perfectly camouflaged trap door isn't known to you or anyone else. The spider will attack the nearest creature of equal size or smaller. It owes you nothing and is not friendly. The size, HD, and damage of the spider depends on the DC of the WIL save: Easy: small, 1 HD, 1d6 damage. Normal: medium, 2 HD, 2d6 damage. Hard: large, 4 HD, 3d6 damage. Extreme: huge, 6 HD, 4d6 damage. The spider dies after L rounds or at 0hp. Passing an extreme WIL save makes the monster permanent.

name: Ward
description: A silver stationary circle appears on the ground surrounding the caster. Choose one specific thing that cannot cross it: Goblins, skeletons, arrows, metal etc. Duration: [HL] Turns.

name: Weal or Woe
description: [HL] allies gain ADV on their next action, attack, or save. Alternatively impose DISADV on the actions, attacks, or saves of [HL] enemies.

name: Web
description: Your wrists can shoot thick webbing. Produce 50' of silken rope or restrain [HL] targets.

name: Wind Scythe
description: Apply a melee attack from a weapon in your hand to a distant target. If you are unarmed it counts as a dagger.

name: Wizard Lock
description: Non-living object or portal closes and becomes magically locked. This spell works on things that aren't technically portals (lock a sword in its scabbard, monster orifices, etc.)
